title: Multiple Choice
summary: A question with several answers; one or more can be correct.
bestFor: Quick knowledge checks after a short section, or testing understanding of a single idea.

title: True / False
summary: One statement the learner marks true or false.
bestFor: Busting myths or checking a single fact; very quick to answer.

title: Single Choice Set
summary: A run of quick one-answer questions, one after another, with a score at the end.
bestFor: Rapid-fire review of several facts in one place.

title: Quiz (Question Set)
summary: A full quiz that mixes question types and shows a final score and feedback.
bestFor: End-of-lesson quizzes where you want one overall result.

title: Summary
summary: The learner builds a summary by picking the correct statement from each group.
bestFor: Reinforcing the key points at the end of a topic.

title: Mark the Words
summary: The learner clicks the words in a passage that answer the question (for example, all the verbs).
bestFor: Close reading, grammar, or spotting key terms in a text.

title: Find the Hotspot
summary: The learner clicks the correct spot on an image.
bestFor: Anatomy, maps, diagrams and screenshots: "show me where".

title: Find Multiple Hotspots
summary: The learner finds several correct spots on an image.
bestFor: Labelling parts of a diagram or finding all the errors in a picture.

title: Multimedia Choice
summary: Multiple choice where the answers are pictures (or audio) instead of text.
bestFor: Visual identification, such as picking the correct diagram or specimen.

title: Fill in the Blanks
summary: The learner types the missing words into a passage.
bestFor: Recalling terminology and vocabulary from memory.

title: Complex Fill the Blanks
summary: Fill in the blanks with richer feedback, and hints for each blank.
bestFor: Longer passages where wrong answers need tailored feedback.

title: Drag the Words
summary: The learner drags words into the gaps in a passage.
bestFor: A gentler alternative to typing; good for beginners or touch screens.

title: Drag and Drop
summary: The learner drags items onto the right places on an image or into categories.
bestFor: Sorting, matching, and labelling diagrams.

title: Sort the Paragraphs
summary: The learner puts paragraphs (or steps) into the right order.
bestFor: Procedures, processes, and how an argument is structured.

title: Image Sequencing
summary: The learner puts images into the right order.
bestFor: Stages of a process, timelines, or step-by-step visuals.

title: Accordion
summary: Collapsible headings that reveal text when clicked.
bestFor: Long reference text, FAQs, and glossaries that would otherwise fill the page.

title: Timeline
summary: A scrolling timeline of events with text and pictures.
bestFor: History, case studies, and any sequence of dated events.

title: Image Slider
summary: A slideshow of images with captions.
bestFor: Galleries, before-and-after comparisons, and photo walkthroughs.

title: Collage
summary: Several pictures arranged in a grid, shown in a chosen layout.
bestFor: A visual overview or a set of related photos.

title: Information Wall
summary: A wall of cards the learner can browse and filter.
bestFor: Browsing many short facts, profiles or resources at once.

title: Virtual Tour (360)
summary: A 360-degree panorama with clickable hotspots and links between scenes.
bestFor: Places that are hard to visit in person: labs, sites, buildings.
notes: Needs 360-degree photographs. The example uses large images, so the page loads more slowly.

title: Chart
summary: A bar or pie chart drawn from numbers you enter.
bestFor: Showing data without making an image of it.

title: Flashcards
summary: Cards with a question on the front; the learner types an answer and flips the card.
bestFor: Self-testing on terms and definitions.

title: Memory Game
summary: Match pairs of cards.
bestFor: Matching terms to pictures or definitions in a lighter way.

title: Course Presentation
summary: Slides that can hold text, images, video and questions, with a score across the whole presentation.
bestFor: A self-contained mini-lesson with checks along the way.

title: Interactive Video
summary: A video that stops at chosen moments to ask questions or show extra information.
bestFor: Keeping learners active while watching a lecture or demonstration.

title: Interactive Book
summary: A multi-chapter book mixing text, media and activities with progress tracking.
bestFor: A whole unit in one place, with a table of contents.

title: Impressive Presentation (alpha)
summary: A 3D, zooming presentation in the style of Prezi.
bestFor: Showy overviews where the movement between ideas matters. Experimental.
notes: Alpha software that was only tested in Chrome. Keep this one for special cases.

title: Essay
summary: The learner writes a short answer which is checked for keywords.
bestFor: Short written responses where you want instant, keyword-based feedback.

title: Questionnaire
summary: A set of survey questions with no right or wrong answers.
bestFor: Course feedback and self-assessment.

title: Personality Quiz
summary: A set of questions whose answers add up to a "which type are you?" result, with no right or wrong answers.
bestFor: Self-assessment, learning styles, and career or role-fit activities.
notes: Gives a result rather than a score, so it counts as complete once viewed.

title: Cornell Notes
summary: A note-taking template with a notes column, cues column and summary.
bestFor: Teaching note-taking while students read or watch.

title: Documentation Tool
summary: A guided form (goals, pages of questions) that the learner can export as a document.
bestFor: Reflective journals, project plans and learning contracts.

title: Structure Strip
summary: A drag-to-arrange strip for planning the parts of a piece of writing.
bestFor: Planning an essay or report structure.

title: Speak the Words
summary: The learner answers aloud and the browser listens.
bestFor: Language learning and pronunciation. Needs a microphone.
notes: Needs a microphone, and speech recognition works in Chrome and Edge but not in every browser.

title: Speak the Words Set
summary: Several spoken-answer questions in a row.
bestFor: Oral practice with several prompts.
notes: Needs a microphone, and speech recognition works in Chrome and Edge but not in every browser.

title: KewAr Code
summary: Makes a scannable QR code for contact details, a web link, a location, a calendar event or a text message.
bestFor: Linking a printed handout, poster or slide to online material, or sharing contact details.
notes: Learners need a phone camera to scan it.
